anchor_scope: Retain source D0 and the complete current-fit residual to the NASA reference. Only molecular G-H0 changes; no unique 0 K limit is inferred for the finite-range fit. H298 control subtracts the 298 K heat-content difference and therefore changes the source zero-energy offset.
thermal_scope: Single-ground-state rigid rotor/harmonic oscillator using measured 48Ti16O2 rotation and gas fundamentals as harmonic frequencies, JANAF mean mass, sigma=2 and spin weight=1. NASA is the continuous old-thermal proxy, not an exact JANAF interpolation.
physical_scope: No anharmonicity, centrifugal distortion, complete excited-state manifold, isotope mixture or independent energy reevaluation. ZPE is already included in D0 and is not added again.
representation: Add the molecular RRHO G-H0 minus the NASA molecular G-H0 to the inherited formation potential. All current-fit residuals to that proxy, source D0 and atomic potentials are retained. No new fit or H298-control energy shift.

decision.name: TiO2
decision.thermal_source: Measured ground-state rotation and gas fundamentals treated as harmonic frequencies; retained fit residual to NASA thermal proxy
decision.reason: Within the declared RRHO approximation, measured rotation and bending are preferable central inputs to the 1973 estimated geometry and bend. Adopt the exact evaluated bounded thermal correction without a separate energy change; fresh cumulative-network validation accompanies the candidate evidence.
decision.condition: 1500-4000 K and one-bar standard pressure. Ground-state RRHO, JANAF mean mass and principal-isotopologue rotation; anharmonicity, full electronic/isotope treatment and complete atmospheric physical accuracy remain unquantified.

interpretation: TiO2-only retained-energy thermal adoption on curated-ps-v1, preserving the cumulative CN, PS and earlier updates.
